verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a scheduling product, so automatically protecting focus time is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers related controls: time budgeting with calendar events, limiting bookings to time blocks, meeting caps, and clustering meetings near each other. None of these shows recurring focus time or habits being defended or moved automatically when conflicts appear.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, the product auto-defends recurring focus time and habits, flexibly moving them when conflicts appear instead of dropping them
